name: framework-agent-prompt
description: Drives `fa explore` against a serving framework with a free-form gap description; reads UI panel inputs, materialises an ExploreRequest, runs plan + optionally execute, surfaces winner_ref + kb_contribution.

templates.default:
@/hyperloom/users/8cf535bc3ad11fa15e48157cf3b3f726/Hyperloom/framework-agent
Use the skill at @/hyperloom/users/8cf535bc3ad11fa15e48157cf3b3f726/Hyperloom/framework-agent/SKILL.md to discover and benchmark upstream framework PRs.

HYPERLOOM_ROOT=/hyperloom/users/8cf535bc3ad11fa15e48157cf3b3f726/Hyperloom
cd "${HYPERLOOM_ROOT}"

# 1. Install framework-agent in editable mode. The install script resolves
#    its own location, so this works regardless of which mount provided
#    the source tree (workspace path during MVP; wekafs in Phase 2).
bash "${HYPERLOOM_ROOT}/framework-agent/scripts/install.sh"

# 2. Environment captured from the UI panel.
Environment:
- FRAMEWORK=$framework                       # sglang | vllm | triton
- REPO_URL=$repoUrl                           # https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang.git
- GAP_DESCRIPTION=$gapDescription             # "improve sglang fp8 MoE on MI300X"
- BASELINE_THROUGHPUT=$baselineThroughput     # e.g. 1.0e8 (tok/s)
- BASELINE_ACCURACY=$baselineAccuracy         # e.g. 0.95 (or empty)
- MAX_CANDIDATES=$maxCandidates               # e.g. 3
- KB_DOMAIN=$kbDomain                         # framework | kernel | empty (=no KB write)
- EXECUTE=$execute                            # "true" / "false"
- PRIMUS_CORTEX_PR_API=http://primus-cortex-pr-api.primus-cortex.svc.cluster.local
- FRAMEWORK_AGENT_KB_DIR=/workspace/framework-agent/kb
- SESSION_DIR=/workspace/framework-agent/$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)

# 3. Materialise an ExploreRequest from the env vars (see
#    ${HYPERLOOM_ROOT}/framework-agent/examples/explore_request_*_sglang.json
#    for the canonical shape). Drop into ${SESSION_DIR}/req.json.
mkdir -p "${SESSION_DIR}" /workspace/framework-agent/kb
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os, pathlib
session = pathlib.Path(os.environ["SESSION_DIR"])
req = {
    "framework": os.environ.get("FRAMEWORK", "sglang"),
    "repo_url": os.environ.get("REPO_URL", "https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang.git"),
    "work_dir": str(session),
    "baseline": {
        "throughput": float(os.environ.get("BASELINE_THROUGHPUT", "1.0")),
        "accuracy": float(os.environ["BASELINE_ACCURACY"]) if os.environ.get("BASELINE_ACCURACY") else None,
        "completed": "1/1",
    },
    "search_perf_prs": True,
    "max_search_candidates": int(os.environ.get("MAX_CANDIDATES", "3")),
    "primus_cortex": {
        "base_url": os.environ["PRIMUS_CORTEX_PR_API"],
        "timeout_sec": 10.0,
    },
    "search_modes": ["primus_cortex"],
    "gap_description": os.environ.get("GAP_DESCRIPTION", ""),
    "prepare_candidate_env": False,
}
kb_domain = os.environ.get("KB_DOMAIN", "").strip()
if kb_domain:
    req["kb_domain"] = kb_domain
(session / "req.json").write_text(json.dumps(req, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
print("wrote", session / "req.json")
PY

# 4. Plan first (always - cheap, no GPU). Verify candidates + audit material.
fa explore --request "${SESSION_DIR}/req.json" --out "${SESSION_DIR}/plan_summary.json"
echo "=== plan candidates ==="
python3 - "${SESSION_DIR}/plan_summary.json" <<'PY'
import json, sys
for c in json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))["candidates"]:
    cnd = c["candidate"]
    print("  ", cnd["ref"], cnd.get("author", ""), cnd.get("head_sha", "")[:12])
PY

# 5. Execute path (gated by $execute). Build / benchmark / accuracy commands
#    must be defined in commands{} - the default template here only does
#    plan, so flip $execute=true and provide a request file with commands
#    to actually exercise GPU.
if [ "${EXECUTE,,}" = "true" ]; then
  fa explore --execute --request "${SESSION_DIR}/req.json" --out "${SESSION_DIR}/exec_summary.json"
  echo "=== winner ==="
  python3 - "${SESSION_DIR}/exec_summary.json" <<'PY'
import json, sys
d = json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
print("winner_ref=", d.get("winner_ref"))
print("kb_contribution=", d.get("kb_contribution"))
PY
fi

# 6. Report.
echo "session_dir=${SESSION_DIR}"
echo "kb_dir=${FRAMEWORK_AGENT_KB_DIR}"
ls -la "${SESSION_DIR}" "${FRAMEWORK_AGENT_KB_DIR}" 2>&1 | head -40
